style_common: Ultra-realistic product photograph, indistinguishable from a real studio photo. Soft diffused daylight from the upper left, gentle natural contact shadow, shallow depth of field, premium minimal e-commerce lifestyle aesthetic. Seamless pale blue-white studio backdrop (#eef3ff) with no visible horizon line. Materials: real-world textures (brushed metal, leather, fabric, ceramic, wood) in white, light grey and natural tones, with ONE tasteful cobalt blue (#1447e0) accent element. Generic unbranded designs, no logos, no text, no watermark, no people, no cartoon or clay look, no outlines. Centered composition with generous margin.
